narrativeProgression.description: The interviewer asks the interviewee how he got into journalism.
The interviewee explains that he decided to pursue journalism relatively late in his academic career.
The interviewee shares that he did an undergraduate degree in philosophy before pursuing a master's in journalism.
The interviewee discusses the impact of COVID-19 on his master's program.
The interviewee describes his lucky break during a Zoom call with a head of talkSPORT.
The interviewee talks about his first job answering phones at talkSPORT and his subsequent move into production.
